purpose: Fix the words this product uses for detected forest loss, and separate the two interval quantities, before either reaches a label.
verificationBasis: Owner statement in the working session. This is a naming decision, not a measurement, and it carries no external attestation.

sourceOfTruth.rule: The module is authoritative. This record restates it so a checker can compare the two and fail when they drift apart.

union.fr: Forêt perdue au moins une fois
union.percentReason: The union is bounded by the forest present in the first year of the window, so that forest is a valid denominator.

sum.percentReason: A cell lost in two years contributes twice, so the total can exceed the forest that ever stood inside the boundary. There is no denominator that makes a percentage of it true.

netChange.reason: A net figure requires a forest-gain or regrowth claim. No gain product has been produced or validated, and a net of zero would read as nothing having happened where a clearcut was replanted.

intervalHeading.reason: Years are written out rather than hyphenated because a screen reader renders a hyphenated pair ambiguously.

retiredWording.reason: Nothing was observed on the ground; a classifier detected a change between two annual mosaics.

scope.internalIdentifierReason: Field names such as observedLossPercent appear in checksum-bound result files. Renaming them would cascade checksum rebinds through records this decision does not touch, for no change a reader can see. The label is what was decided; the storage key is not.
